items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: That's the way I met Keg. When I went into the Frolic he stayed with me for eleven years.

ctx.x: That's the way I met Keg. When I went into the Frolic he stayed with me for eleven years.
I guess he's the best you ever had, next to A.G. Godley.
